text.p: The average yields at auctions of three-month treasury bills slipped from the last sale on March 4, and six-, nine- and 12-month treasury bills yields slipped from the last sale on March 5, the central bank said Friday.

Three-month bills slipped to 25.97 percent from 26.10 percent, six-month bills edged down to 31.51 percent from 32.03 percent, nine-month bills slipped to 34.88 percent from 34.92 percent, and 12-month bills eased to 38.00 percent from 38.02 percent.
The results of Thursday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 6.00 million UAH 8.08 million UAH
Amount sold 6.00 million UAH 8.077 million UAH
Actual amount raised 5.63 million UAH 7.58 million UAH
The central bank sold 60,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 47,423 were competitive and 12,577 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 11.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 9.80 million UAH 8.73 million UAH
Amount sold 9.80 million UAH 8.73 million UAH
Actual amount raised 8.47 million UAH 7.53 million UAH
The central bank sold 98,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 48,153 were competitive and 49,847 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 11.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 25.00 million UAH 11.04 million UAH
Amount sold 18.42 million UAH 11.04 million UAH
Actual amount raised 14.61 million UAH 8.75 million UAH
The central bank sold 184,215 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 153,935 were competitive and 30,280 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 11.
The results of 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 31.00 million UAH 12.09 million UAH
Amount sold 31.00 million UAH 7.009 million UAH
Actual amount raised 22.48 million UAH 5.08 million UAH
The central bank sold 310,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 296,907 were competitive and 13,093 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 11.
